svg.title: Product sheet: reduce decorative texture without altering the object
svg.desc: Only backdrop-pattern opacity changes 0.65→0.1 on a fixed #e7e3d8 field. The same native wave pattern and identical RGBA pitcher cutout stay in place. Source bytes, alpha, object scale, copy, font settings, paper and lighting remain identical. This is a photographic cutout on a designed backdrop, not a retouched scene. Fictional example. Reused generated photographic assets and native composition.
svg.text: BEFORE · Strong waves behind the pitcher
Only the declared background opacity changes. Foreground content, type, image crop and presentation stay fixed.
